title: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Vegetable Fried Rice is a classic Chinese-style wok dish made with fluffy, separate grains of jasmine or basmati rice tossed with colorful vegetables, aromatic garlic, ginger, onions, and savory soy sauce. High-heat cooking creates a lightly smoky wok hei character while sesame oil adds a fragrant finish.

ingredients.title: For the Rice
items: Long-grain jasmine rice or basmati rice – 2 cups

ingredients.title: For the Vegetables
items: Peas – ½ cup, fresh or frozen
Red bell pepper – ½, finely diced
Green bell pepper – ½, finely diced

ingredients.title: For the Sauce & Seasoning
items: Soy sauce – 2–3 tbsp (light soy for flavor and dark soy for color)
White pepper or black pepper – ½ tsp

instruction.title: Step 1 – Preparing the Rice
steps: Rinse the rice several times until the water runs mostly clear.
Cook the rice with water, salt, and 1 tsp oil until tender.
Spread the cooked rice out and allow it to cool completely.
For the best fried rice texture, refrigerate the cooked rice overnight before stir-frying.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Preparing the Vegetables
steps: Dice the carrot, bell peppers, and onion uniformly for even cooking.
Finely chop the spring onions and keep the white and green portions ready.
Prepare the minced garlic and grated ginger before heating the wok.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Stir-Frying the Vegetables
steps: Heat 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add garlic, ginger, and chopped onion and stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add carrots, peas, and bell peppers.
Stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Adding the Rice
steps: Push the vegetables toward the sides of the wok.
Add a small amount of oil to the center and add the cold cooked rice.
Break up any clumps with a spatula and stir-fry over high heat for 2–3 minutes.
Toss the rice and vegetables together until evenly combined.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Seasoning & Finishing
steps: Add soy sauce, oyster sauce if using, and white or black pepper.
Toss quickly over high heat until the rice is evenly seasoned.
Taste and adjust the salt if necessary.
Drizzle with sesame oil and give the fried rice one final quick toss.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Garnishing & Serving
steps: Sprinkle chopped spring onions over the fried rice.
Add optional fried shallots, toasted sesame seeds, or fresh coriander.
Serve immediately while hot as a main dish or side dish.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot as a main vegetarian dish.
Pair with Chinese-style chili chicken, hot garlic vegetables, or other stir-fried dishes.
Garnish with spring onions, fried shallots, toasted sesame seeds, or fresh coriander for extra texture and freshness.

chefTips: Use day-old refrigerated rice whenever possible; cold, dry grains remain separate and prevent soggy fried rice.
Cook over high heat to develop the signature smoky wok hei flavor.
Avoid constant stirring; use quick tossing motions to encourage light searing and crispness.
Keep the vegetables crisp-tender rather than soft for better texture and color.
Add soy sauce gradually to prevent the rice from becoming overly salty or wet.
Build flavor in layers with garlic, ginger, onion, soy sauce, and sesame oil for a balanced restaurant-style finish.
